notes.title: Update 3 (02/09/2016)
notes.content:
Today's update has, among other minor fixes, a fix for the double input issue that some people were experiencing. Thanks to those of you who reported the issue in the forums!

In this build:

    Fixed issue some people were experiencing whereby each button press was interpretted twice
    Minor input handling improvements
    Fixed issue where main menu screen goes blank after idling for 30 seconds.
    Added build number to main menu screen

notes.title: Update 2 - DualShock 4 controller support
notes.content:
Today's update adds support for the DualShock 4 contoller. It's a feature that's been requested for a while now, but was previously unfeasable due some technical limitations. I did a lot of testing with the dualshock whilst putting together this patch and it works well provided the controller is plugged in via USB. 

Some minor bugs to do with UI positioning were also fixed in this patch.

Notes:

    The game will only attempt to detect a DualShock 4 controller upon launch, so a make sure your controller is plugged in before launching the game.
    Due to a technical limitation, in-game pausing is disabled while using the DualShock 4 controller.
    Due to another technical limitation, controller vibration is disabled while using the DualShock 4 controller.

notes.title: Update 1 (12/07/2016)
notes.content:
Fixed occurences of a global leaderboard displaying as blank if you had not previously submitted a score to it
    Fixed occurences of global leaderboards displaying an incorrect range 
    Key bindings for scrolling up/down leaderboard entries work correctly now
    Fixed an event whereby refreshing the friends leaderboard causes non-friends to appear in the list 
    Reworked score caching system
